3:4 carousel template

Your profile grid is 3:4 and Instagram supports 3:4 photos in the feed. Slides made at 1080 × 1440 look the same in both places.

  1. In this package: carousel-blank-1080x1440.png (a cream starting slide) and carousel-margin-overlay-1080x1440.png (transparent guide).
  2. In Canva: Create a design → Custom size → 1080 × 1440 px. Upload the overlay, drop it on top of each slide while you design, and delete it before you download.
  3. The skeleton: slide 1 is the first hook; slide 2 is a second first impression and must make sense on its own; the middle explains and proves; the last slide is the action.
  4. Keep it readable: about 25 words or fewer per slide, text inside the dashed margin, and at least one real photo or proof slide.
  5. The action goes on the last slide and in the caption. Use as many slides as the argument needs, and no more.
Your 30 carousel templates (with the $1K Challenge) are in My Account → Challenge Content.
